title: Replace the arXiv placeholder once the preprint is posted
description:
paper.md, README.md (Citing block) and docs/ carry the deliberate placeholder XXXX.XXXXX instead of a plausible-looking fake arXiv id, so that no reader or citation manager mistakes it for a real record.

When the preprint is posted:
1. Replace XXXX.XXXXX with the real identifier in README.md (bibtex eprint + url) and anywhere else it appears (grep -rn 'XXXX.XXXXX').
2. Remove the paragraph in README.md explaining that the identifier is a placeholder.
3. Add the arXiv badge to the README header row.
4. Note the posting date in preregistration/, alongside the pre-registration hash.

Blocked on: the study having results, or a decision to post the Stage 1 registered report on its own.
